AfterRoomEntered.maps_to: no counterpart; lava_lamp.py is a behaviourless stub (3 class attributes, no methods)
AfterRoomEntered.issue: LavaLamp.cs:36-40 clears TookDamageThisCombat on EVERY room entry (the parameter is AbstractRoom, not CombatRoom). The sim's Relic base has the hook -- `after_room_entered(run, point, room_type)` (relics/base.py:194-195), dispatched over run.relics at run.py:983 as the room is entered and already used by relic/silver_crucible -- so the pipeline is live and the port simply declines it. EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b08.py b08-lavalamp): `hasattr(Relic, 'after_room_entered')` is True and the relic class body is just ['id', 'name', 'rarity']. Carries guard G1's LIVE label as one third of the missing relic; recorded separately because the flag's LIFETIME is per-room here, not per-combat, which a fix must get right (a combat-start-only reset would leave the flag set after a non-combat room). Rule 7: relics/base.py and run.py are not hashed by this record.

AfterDamageReceived.issue: LavaLamp.cs:42-62 sets TookDamageThisCombat when FOUR guards pass: the current room is a CombatRoom, the target is the owner's creature, `result.UnblockedDamage > 0`, and the damage does NOT carry ValueProp.Unblockable. The sim's HookSystem.on_damage_received exists and passes target, amount, dealer, card and props (hooks.py:453-467), so every one of the four is expressible: the props argument carries the ValueProp typing precisely so listeners can gate on it. Nothing is implemented. Note the Unblockable exclusion is unusual and load-bearing -- Poison and Regret-style HP loss must NOT spoil the relic -- and a fix that gates only on `amount > 0` would be wrong. Carries guard G1's LIVE label. Rule 7: hooks.py are not hashed by this record.

TryModifyCardRewardOptionsLate.maps_to: no counterpart; the sim's slot is Relic.modify_card_reward_options (relics/base.py:172-176), dispatched at rewards.py:299-301
TryModifyCardRewardOptionsLate.issue: Rollup of guards G1 and G2 per binding rule 4. LavaLamp.cs:64-89 clones and Upgrades every upgradable card-reward option when the combat was damage-free.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the whole relic is missing -- a damage-free combat's card rewards are not upgraded -- and the port's stated premise is FALSE
guards.issue: MECHANISM: the three hooks above compose into 'if you took no unblockable-excluded damage this combat, every upgradable card reward option arrives Upgraded'. PREMISE CHECK (PROMPT.md bug class 12): lava_lamp.py:8-9 says 'a card-reward modifier applied after combat, so this is a no-op stub'. All three pipelines are live -- the shared sweep-stub-premises already reports AfterRoomEntered -> after_room_entered and TryModifyCardRewardOptionsLate -> modify_card_reward_options as dispatched, and this batch confirms the third. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes_b08.py b08-lavalamp): Lava Lamp is Shop rarity in the transcribed grab bag (b08-pool), and a MONSTER card reward comes out [('headbutt', 0), ('rampage', 0), ('colossus', 0)] both with and without the relic, while the SAME sim hook with relic/silver_crucible held yields [('headbutt', 1), ('rampage', 1), ('colossus', 1)]. So the sim can do exactly this, today, through the very hook the port declines. The observable is a permanently weaker deck for the rest of the run, and it is deck-parity visible: conformance/runner.py compares the deck as (id, upgrade_level) pairs. Rule 7: relics/base.py, rewards.py, relics/silver_crucible.py, hooks.py and conformance/runner.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: G2 (DORMANT, but the fix must not reproduce it): C# UPGRADES A CLONE -- `RunState.CloneCard(card)` then `CardCmd.Upgrade(card2)` then `cardReward.ModifyCard(card2, this)` (LavaLamp.cs:83-85) -- and the sim has no clone helper
guards.issue: PROMPT.md bug class 17. CardModel.CreateClone is ClonePreservingMutability (CardModel.cs:2168-2179) and carries the card's enchantment, affliction, keyword edits and local energy-cost modifiers as well as its upgrade level; .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md sweep E establishes by execution that every sim rebuild drops all but the upgrade level, and audit/records/relic/burning_sticks.json G3 records the mechanism as LIVE at its own site. The reason C# clones at all here is that a CardCreationResult keeps the ORIGINAL alongside the modified card, so the un-upgraded option survives for the run-history screen. DORMANT AT THIS SITE for a reason that is specific and worth stating: the cards being cloned are freshly generated reward options that carry no per-instance state yet -- create_reward_cards makes them with make_card and, apart from the upgrade roll, nothing has touched them -- EXCEPT that the LATE pass runs after relic/glitter and relic/silken_tress may already have enchanted them, in which case C#'s clone keeps the enchantment and a sim rebuild would drop it. So the fix must mutate the option in place (as relics/silver_crucible.py:28-34 and relics/glitter.py:16-21 do) rather than copy it. Filed so that closing G1 does not open a class-17 instance. Rule 7: src/Core/Models/CardModel.cs, rewards.py, relics/glitter.py, relics/silken_tress.py and relics/silver_crucible.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N1: `card.IsUpgradable` guards the Upgrade (LavaLamp.cs:81) -- PROMPT.md bug class 14
guards.rationale: C# checks IsUpgradable (`CurrentUpgradeLevel < MaxUpgradeLevel`, CardModel.cs:785-789) BEFORE cloning and upgrading, so it never marks a curse or status as upgraded. Recorded because class 14 has fired twice already (astrolabe G1, bone_tea) and the sim's Card.upgrade() (cards/base.py:146-147) is a bare increment: a G1 fix MUST reproduce this guard, and `Card.is_upgradable` (cards/base.py:168-170) is the member to use. Nothing to compare today -- the port has no call -- so this entry is a pre-emptive pin rather than a divergence. Rule 7: src/Core/Models/CardModel.cs and cards/base.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N2: `base.Owner.RunState.CurrentRoom is CombatRoom` on BOTH AfterDamageReceived and TryModifyCardRewardOptionsLate (LavaLamp.cs:44-47, 66-69), and `player != base.Owner` (line 70)
guards.rationale: PROMPT.md bug class 15 (paired hooks rarely carry the same guard set) checked and CLEARED for this unit: the two behavioural hooks carry the SAME room guard, and the reward hook adds only the multiplayer owner comparison, which the contract puts in maps_to rather than treating as a divergence. The room guard confines the relic to combat card rewards -- it must not upgrade an event's or a shop's card options -- and since the sim's modify_card_reward_options is reached from create_reward_cards for BOTH combat rewards and Lead Paperweight's out-of-combat offer (relics/lead_paperweight.py:24-28), a G1 fix that omits the room check would wrongly upgrade the latter. Recorded as the concrete trap in the fix. Rule 7: relics/lead_paperweight.py and rewards.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.rationale: The flag is serialised because AfterRoomEntered, not a combat boundary, owns its lifetime -- so the belt_buckle shape (PROMPT.md bug class 13) is not what a fix needs; a per-room clear is. `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-reset` puts lava_lamp in the 200-relic 'holds no state' bucket only because the port holds no state at all, so the sweep gives no guidance here and this entry supplies it.
